title: Add ReelHeist to your browser
subtitle: Follow these 3 quick steps to finish setup:
step1_desc: Copy this address, paste it into your browser address bar, and press Enter:
step2_desc: Turn on the "Developer mode" switch in the top-right corner.
step3_desc: Click "Load unpacked" and select or paste this extension folder path:
note_devmode_desc: Browsers may show a reminder when running unpacked extensions in Developer mode. This is normal—keep the extension enabled.
note_smartscreen_desc: If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" when running the installer, click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
reload_desc: Open your browser Extensions page and click the Reload (↻) icon on the ReelHeist card.
